_comment: Where each agent CLI expects its global instruction file and its skills.
agentsync reads this; nothing else hardcodes CLI paths. Adding support for a
new CLI is an entry here plus a commit — every machine picks it up on its
next sync with no local edits.
detect:  ANY command exiting 0 means the CLI is present on this machine.
Undetected CLIs are skipped, not failed.
method:  'symlink' -> the path becomes a symlink to principles/AGENTS.md.
'import'  -> the path is a real file that must contain @<abs-path>
lines; agentsync adds them without touching other content.
machine_local: true means this CLI ALSO needs ~/.config/agents/MACHINE.md.
Import-capable CLIs get it as a second @import. Symlink CLIs cannot
import, so they reach it via the pointer in principles/AGENTS.md.
post:    structured adapters with check/apply commands, for wiring a symlink cannot express. Both commands must be idempotent and check must never write.

clis.name: cursor
clis.note: No global instruction file: verified by probing cursor-agent. It walks ancestors for AGENTS.md, so ~/AGENTS.md covers projects UNDER $HOME but nothing outside it. `post` installs a project-level .cursor/rules symlink for repos under ~/dev, which also covers repos whose own AGENTS.md belongs to another tool. Projects outside $HOME still need it installed explicitly.

clis.name: dsh
clis.note: Weft Fabric manages explicit per-skill links so additions and removals converge like every other CLI.
